t: Meeting Of Members Of The Anti-Imperialism Federation

pages.en:
D.5477
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL
C. & S. B. REGI...
No. D
Date ...... / ...... / ......

November 21 33.

Sir,

I have to acknowledge, with thanks, receipt
of your letter No.78 of November 17 conveying information
about a meeting which the members of the World Anti-
Imperialism Federation had planned to hold on November 18,
and to add that due precautions were instituted, but
the meeting did not take place.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,

(Sd) F W Garrard

Commissioner of Police.

General Wen Hung En,
Chief of the Public Safety Bureau,
Shanghai.

1933年11月21日。

先生：

谨此致谢，确认收到阁下11月17日第78号来函，该函通报了世界反帝同盟成员计划于11月18日举行会议的情报。兹补充说明，我方已采取必要预防措施，但该会议并未举行。

此致，
阁下恭顺的仆人，

（签名）F W Garrard

警务处处长。

温宏恩将军，
上海市公安局局长，
上海。

Date November 20, 19 33

Subject (in full) Proposed demonstration by Radical Elements.

Made by and Forwarded by C. D. I. Prince

Sir,
On receipt of the attached translation of a Despatch
from the Public Safety Bureau regarding a proposed demonstra-
tion by Radical Elements on Nov 18 information was circulated through
the C. C. R. to all stations in order that precautions
might be taken.
No assembly as described took place.

Officer i/c Sp. Br.
C. D. I.

Reg.
Please acknowledge letter
from General War.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE.

Translation of Despatch bearing Character Tseng No. 78 from Public Safety Bureau.

November 17, 193 3.

Confidential

To
Major F. W. Gerrard,
Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council.

Sir,
According to a confidential report, members
of the World's Anti-Imperialism Federation, a
Communistic organization, will assemble in and
around the Commercial Press Co. Ltd., Honan Road
between 9 a.m. and 10 a.m. on the 18th inst. Who-
ever taking newspapers in their hands with the
page containing advertisements on the top will
serve as a secret sign that they lead fellow
members to attend the meeting. I request that
you take note and instruct your men to be atten-
tive and to arrest offenders accordingly.

(Signed): Wen Hung-en,
Chief of the Bureau.

1933年11月17日。

机密

致：
F. W. Gerrard 少校，
警务处处长，
上海公共租界工部局。

先生：
据密报，共产主义组织“世界反帝同盟”的成员将于本月18日上午9时至10时之间，在河南路商务印书馆有限公司内外及其周边聚集。凡手持报纸且头版刊登广告者，即作为秘密信号，表明其正带领其他成员参加会议。请阁下知悉，并指令所属警员保持警惕，据此逮捕违法者。

（签名）：温宏恩，
局长。
